mapper.select: SELECT status FROM user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.status FROM user_role_assignment ura JOIN role r ON r.tenant_id = ura.tenant_id AND r.role_id = ura.role_id WHERE ura.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ura.user_id = #{userId} AND ura.state = 'GRANTED' AND r.role_code = #{roleCode}

SELECT u.status AS user_status, r.status AS role_status, ura.state AS assignment_state, 1 + COALESCE(u.lock_version,0) + CASE WHEN r.role_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + COALESCE(r.lock_version,0) + CASE WHEN ura.role_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + COALESCE(ura.lock_version,0) AS qualification_version FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN role r ON r.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND r.role_code=#{roleCode} LEFT JOIN user_role_assignment ura ON ura.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND ura.user_id=u.user_id AND ura.role_id=r.role_id WHERE u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.user_id=#{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_role_assignment ura JOIN role r ON r.tenant_id = ura.tenant_id AND r.role_id = ura.role_id WHERE ura.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ura.user_id = #{userId} AND ura.state = 'GRANTED' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.role_code = #{roleCode}
